exchanges: ugh morning, slept terribly, the neighbours had a party till late
Oof, that's rough, hope the coffee is strong today.
first week at kestrel done and honestly i think i like it
That's great to hear, a good start makes all the difference.
they gave me the title cartographer which still sounds made up to me lol
It sounds pretty grand, you should get business cards.
my sister ines finally signed for a place in wexcombe, shes buzzing
Aw, a new home is such a big step, good for her.
going to try and cook something proper tonight instead of toast
Go for it, even a simple pasta beats toast.
dara came over with her sphynx in a little jumper, i cant cope
A hairless cat in a jumper is peak cuteness.
weather's grim, my umbrella turned inside out on the way in
Classic, those things never survive a proper gust.
my sister in law is renting a cottage out in dunmere for the year
That sounds peaceful, a cottage stint could be lovely.
booked my first fencing lesson, pray for me
Exciting, you'll be lunging like a pro in no time.
work is mostly drainage maps so far, weirdly soothing
Soothing work is underrated, honestly.
the micra made that grinding noise again on the way home
Uh oh, might be worth getting the car looked at soon.
my coworker ottoline has basically adopted me, she showed me where all the good snacks are
Having a work ally that early is gold.
might binge something tonight, havent decided what yet
A cosy night in sounds well earned.
dara says mothball only eats if you sit with him, spoiled boy
Ha, sounds like he has her well trained.
ines's boyfriend rafferty is doing all the heavy lifting for the move
That's love, carrying boxes up the stairs.
im so tired, early night for me
Good plan, rest up.
cracked the screen on my fairphone, at least you can swap the parts yourself
Lucky it's the repairable kind, that'll save you a fortune.
my brother keeps sending me memes at work, im going to get caught
Maybe mute him during office hours.
dara wants to do a picnic if it ever stops raining
Fingers crossed for a dry spell.
lunch was leftovers again, i need to get better at this
A bit of meal prep at the weekend might help.
had a nice chat with my mum on the phone, she sounds well
That's lovely, it's nice when they sound good.
found a secondhand copy of saltmarsh and im hooked already
Nothing better than a book that grabs you straight away.
my sister in law wants us all down at hers soon, could be fun
A trip out to the countryside sounds nice.
anyway, off to make tea, chat later
Enjoy, talk soon.
